name: The Unexpected Heiress
source:
In 1913, you're sent off to England to become a viscountess. Will forbidden love catch you unawares... and will you be able to solve a deadly mystery?

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Unexpected_Heiress]Choices Wikia[/url]]
translation:
1913年，你被派往英国成为子爵夫人。禁忌之爱会让你措手不及……你能解开一个致命的谜团吗？

[来自[url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/The_Unexpected_Heiress]Choices Wikia[/url]]
